# Monthly transactions

Volumes, values, mix and anomaly flags for `mart_monthly_transactions`.

## Monthly totals

```{r}
#| echo: false
tot <- read_table("txn_monthly_totals")
if (!is.null(tot)) print(utils::tail(tot, 24)) else cat("No monthly totals in this run.\n")
```

## Channel mix over time

Shares are compositional; they sum to 1 per month. When modelling shares use
log-ratio transforms, not raw percentages.

```{r}
#| echo: false
mix <- read_table("txn_mix_channel")
if (!is.null(mix)) print(utils::head(mix, 30)) else cat("No mix table in this run.\n")
```

## Anomaly flags

Period-over-period changes with robust z-scores. Points are **flagged, never deleted**.

```{r}
#| echo: false
anom <- read_table("txn_anomaly_flags")
if (!is.null(anom)) {
  flagged <- anom[anom$flag, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(flagged)) print(flagged) else cat("No flagged anomalies in this run.\n")
} else {
  cat("No anomaly table in this run.\n")
}
```

## Forecast

A forecast is only reported if it beats seasonal-naive on a rolling-origin
backtest (`backtest_forecast()`). Requires `tsibble`/`fable` installed.
